name: 08243 · Sea Isle City, NJ
findings: ZIP 08243 (Sea Isle City) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (69%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08243 (Sea Isle City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
